## Objective
- Build a complete playable browser game where the player is a Team Rocket grunt stealing Pokémon, ranking up, upgrading a base, and unlocking larger Boss-rank base expansions.

## Requirements
- Single-player game from Team Rocket perspective.
- Start as grunt; steal Pokémon to earn reputation and ranks.
- Unlock base upgrades while ranking up.
- At Boss rank, unlock further base upgrades/expansion and make the base bigger.
- Save screenshots as small JPEGs, viewport max 1280px, read only latest image.
- Complete game now; no clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Built a static vanilla HTML/CSS/JS game, no npm/build dependencies, served by existing default static server.
- Game loop: job board → partner prep → turn-based heist → capture/result → credits/rep/heat → facility upgrades → promotion → Boss expansions → final Mewtwo heist.
- Rank ladder: Grunt, Runner, Agent, Lieutenant, Executive, Boss at rep thresholds `0, 40, 110, 220, 360, 520`.
- Facilities: Storage Bay, Training Dojo, Forgery Lab, Getaway Garage, Propaganda Office, Bribe Network; base max level 5, plus 1 per Boss expansion.
- Boss expansions: East Wing ($1,600), Underground Vault ($3,000), Rooftop Deck ($4,800); each adds capacity, bonus, and +1 facility cap.
- Final win condition: after all 3 expansions, steal Mewtwo from Cerulean Cave; sets `state.finalWon`/`state.empire`.
- Persistence via `localStorage` key `rocket-redline-save-v1`; intro Start button labeled exactly `Start` for capture auto-start.

## Work State
### Completed
- Core game logic in `js/game.js` and species/mission/facility data in `js/data.js`.
- UI system, icons, sounds, toasts, modals, intro, base/ops/roster/heist views, responsive CSS.
- Tested intro, base, job board, prep modal, heist, result modal, roster on desktop and mobile.
- Fixed `U.ui.*` bug in `js/ui-modals.js` / `js/ui-init.js` by replacing with `U.*`.
- Fixed final mission removal after Mewtwo success.
- Added duplicate-species prevention for generated mission boards.
- Started adding a heist bottom “JOB VALUE / PARTNER EDGE / TACTICAL READ” panel and CSS.

### Active
- Finish heist footer styling/responsive layout.
- Improve mobile heist so action buttons are reachable without excessive scrolling.
- Add mobile-promotion CTA and hide mobile bottom nav during heists.
- Re-render after `close-modal` so promotion/modal closes refresh underlying UI.
- Test Boss expansion screens, promotion flow, and victory flow.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli` expected browser path `~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243`; fixed with symlink to `chromium-1254`.

## Next Move
1. Add mobile promotion pill to `index.html`, toggle it in `renderMobileNav`, and ensure `data-action="promote"` works from it.
2. In `R.ui.render`, toggle `document.body.classList` (e.g. `in-heist`) when `state.heist` exists; hide `.mobile-nav` during heist and reduce bottom padding.
